questions.question: What do you do to stay focused while studying or working?
questions.translation: ماذا تفعل لتبقى مركزاً أثناء الدراسة أو العمل؟
suggested_answers: I organise my time and avoid distractions to stay focused.
I take short breaks and study in a quiet place to concentrate well.
I manage my time and turn off my phone while studying.

questions.question: How would you manage your time if you have exams next week?
questions.translation: كيف ستنظم وقتك إذا كانت لديك امتحانات الأسبوع القادم؟
suggested_answers: I would make a study schedule and revise each subject every day.
I would organise my time, study the important subjects first, and take short breaks.
I would plan my revision, set priorities, and study a little every day.

questions.question: What advice would you give to someone who always arrives late?
questions.translation: ما النصيحة التي ستقدمها لشخص يصل متأخراً دائماً؟
suggested_answers: I would advise him to organise his time and set an alarm.
I would tell him to plan ahead and leave home earlier.
I would advise him to be punctual and respect other people's time.

questions.question: Where did you spend your last holiday?
suggested_answers: I spent my last holiday in Damascus.
I visited my grandparents in the countryside.
I spent my last holiday in Latakia by the sea.

questions.question: Who did you go with?
suggested_answers: I went with my parents and my brother.
